answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Interest & Insurance Question ID: 39042 Country: India Title: What can be done with the interest amount credited in bank account Question: What can be done with the interest amount credited in bank account? Can it be given to a widow, who does not have any source of income? Answer ID: 39042 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1050/874/B=1433) The interest money received from bank account should be given in charity to the poor, needy ones and miserable debtor without the intention of reward. A widow woman who has no income source and does not possess jewellery equal to nisab then you can also give her interest money. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
